req.title: Return PUT request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PUT /put with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /put returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests are designed to: (1) verify the positive path with a plain PUT request, (2) verify JSON body payload reflection, (3) verify form data reflection, (4) verify query-string args reflection, (5) test the negative path with a wrong HTTP method (GET to /put), (6) test boundary of empty body vs non-empty body. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_returns_200_with_required_keys
expected: JSON body contains exactly keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: response JSON must include url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_returns_200_with_required_keys():
    r = client.put('/put')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body is not None
    required_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == required_keys

test_put_returns_200_with_required_keys()

tests.name: test_put_reflects_json_payload
actions: Send PUT /put with Content-Type application/json and JSON body {"key": "value"}
expected: response body 'data' field is non-empty string
response body 'form' field is empty dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: JSON body reflecting PUT payload
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_reflects_json_payload():
    payload = json.dumps({"key": "value"})
    r = client.put('/put', data=payload, content_type='application/json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {"key": "value"}
    assert body['form'] == {}
    assert body['data'] == payload

test_put_reflects_json_payload()

tests.name: test_put_reflects_form_data
actions: Send PUT /put with Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded and form field foo=bar
expected: response body 'data' field is empty string
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: form field reflected in response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_reflects_form_data():
    r = client.put('/put', data={'foo': 'bar'}, content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['form'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''

test_put_reflects_form_data()

expected: response body 'headers' field contains X-Test-Header with value sentinel
trace: R-HTTPBIN-006: headers field reflects incoming request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_headers_field_reflects_sent_header():
    r = client.put('/put', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    headers = body['headers']
    assert isinstance(headers, dict)
    assert headers.get('X-Test-Header') == 'sentinel'

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_empty_body_json_field_is_none():
    r = client.put('/put', data=b'', content_type='application/octet-stream')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['form'] == {}

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_put_with_raw_data_body():
    raw = 'plain text body'
    r = client.put('/put', data=raw, content_type='text/plain')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == raw
